title: Pocket Dashboard MVP: scope reduction, trade-offs, and acceptance criteria
creator: Asha Patel
description: PRD excerpt and decision log for a reduced-scope 'Pocket Dashboard' MVP: deliver a minimal, fast-loading console surface that gives teams quick signal-to-action for latency, errors, and per-route cost without the full dashboard/tracing stack. This ticket captures scope cuts, trade-offs, required engineering/design work, and acceptance criteria so the team can ship a usable slice within the next cycle.
decision_record: Scope cuts made to meet timeline: 1) Replace full trace viewer with a lightweight "span-summary" card (counts, p50/p95, error rate) + deep-link to full traces in a later release; 2) Limit cost breakdown to 'top 5 routes by token spend' and per-route 24h delta instead of historical time-series; 3) Limit dashboard cards to a maximum of 4 compact tiles (latency, errors, throughput, cost) with focused drill targets; 4) Defer annotations, user-segment filters, and exported CSVs to post-MVP. These decisions prioritize initial performance, low memory footprint in console, and minimal backend aggregation work.
acceptance_criteria: Pocket Dashboard page loads in < 600ms on desktop for orgs with <= 1M monthly tokens (lab measured)
Four compact cards implemented: Latency (p50/p95), Error Rate (5xx and user-defined errors), Throughput (requests/sec), Cost (top-5 routes by spend)
Each card shows current value and 24h delta; cost card shows currency and token units with a link to billing dashboard for full breakdown

Lightweight tracing surface implemented as 'Span Summary' card: aggregated span counts, top-3 erroring operations, p95 latency; clicking 'View trace' opens full trace viewer (feature-flagged and can return 404 if not yet provisioned)
Trace sampling default set to 0.5% for Pocket Dashboard queries to limit backend load; sampling rate configurable behind a release flag
End-to-end e2e smoke tests validate cards render with mocked metrics and the primary deep-links (billing, full traces, route details) resolve
Design sign-off obtained on compact tiles and mobile breakpoint (link to Drive mock in updates)
updates: 2025-02-11: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Liam) and Design (Marta). Reviewed constraints: backend aggregation cost and console slow-first-paint issues from previous alpha.

2025-02-12: Decided to cut time-series charts and complex filters for MVP. Trade-off: less historical context vs. much faster load and simpler backend queries. Documented in PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Pocket+Dashboard+PRD
2025-02-18: Design delivered compact tile mocks (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcPocketTilesMock. Designer note: tiles are 3 lines of text + icon to minimize DOM nodes.
2025-02-20: Engineering review: implementing span-summary requires new aggregation endpoint (ENG-58901). Agreed to add a sampling guard and fallback empty-state when aggregation is delayed.
2025-02-24: PM sync: reduced acceptance criteria to measurable perf goals and explicit sampling defaults. Added e2e smoke tests acceptance.

2025-02-26: Security reviewed quick deep-link behavior; determined no new privileges required for launching deep-links to existing trace viewer (security sign-off link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Sec/Pocket+Dashboard+Review)
2025-03-01: Design approved final tile copy; UX requested microcopy for 'cost' tile that clarifies 'estimated' billing. Updated copy in Drive mock.

2025-03-03: Eng raised implementation risk: full-route-cost aggregation may take two extra sprints for accurate historical cost; fallback will show 'estimated' and link to billing for reconciliation. Added dependency: ENG-59222 for billing-join work.
notes: If backend aggregation latency exceeds SLA during rollout, enable fallback to precomputed metrics (older 1h cache) and open a follow-up ticket to improve freshness. Plan for a 2-week post-launch 'quality gate' to measure card reliability and sampling impact on trace storage costs.
